purpose: Teach: 大袈裟/串/コースター/灯り/偽物/同年代/重たい/ピーマン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、大袈裟、絶対、に、絶対、言うなよ
lines.en: Riku — seriously, don't you dare make a big deal out of this.
lines.style: Light, warning edge. Quick opening. Leans forward slightly. The tone of someone who cares about something and is pretending not to. Eyebrow raised. Casual-wry surface, real concern underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭で、本気で、絶対、串、絶対、団子、絶対、買ったぜ、桜
lines.en: You actually bought those skewered dumplings at the festival, Sakura. Don't even.
lines.style: Playful deflection, eyes bright with teasing. Faster pace than hers. Leans back, arms crossed, but relaxed. The deflection of someone caught and enjoying being caught. Half-smirk.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のスマホの、本気で、絶対、コースター、絶対、可愛いね
lines.en: Your phone coaster is actually really cute, Riku.
lines.style: Softer gear shift. Genuine observation delivered without fanfare. Straightforward, no performance. A small compliment that means something because it's unguarded. Almost matter-of-fact warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のスタンドの、本気で、絶対、灯り、絶対、お洒落だな、桜
lines.en: Your desk lamp is pretty stylish, Sakura.
lines.style: Matched tone to hers — genuine, unperformed. Steady eye contact level. The compliment of someone testing whether it's safe to be sincere. Quiet conviction underneath the simplicity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の、本気で、絶対、偽物、絶対、のサングラス、絶対、バレたよ
lines.en: Your knockoff sunglasses got exposed, Riku.
lines.style: Teasing snap forward. Sharp, bright laughter in the voice. Pointing it out with the delight of catching him in something small and harmless. Quick pace, landing with satisfaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、同年代、絶対、で、絶対、強い、絶対、選手、絶対、知ってる?桜
lines.en: Do you know any strong athletes around our age, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, slight hesitation underneath. The setup before a question that matters. Casual phrasing masking real interest. Open, almost vulnerable tone — not performing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のリュック、本気で、絶対、重たい、絶対、よね
lines.en: Your backpack is actually pretty heavy, huh.
lines.style: Wry observation, light and conversational. Low-key noticing. The way you mention something you've caught about someone without making it mean anything. Casual, but the noticing is real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお弁当の、本気で、絶対、ピーマン、絶対、肉詰め、絶対、ウマかったぜ、桜
lines.en: That stuffed green pepper in your bento was actually really good, Sakura.
lines.style: Direct, warm, specific compliment delivered without hesitation. Steady voice. The honesty of someone saying exactly what he means about something she made. Genuine appreciation, no backpedaling.
